'''Brawk''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and served aboard a [[Imperial Customs Frigate|customs frigate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. On one occasion, Brawk's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] stopped an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] ship carrying a venerable [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Unidentified alien philosopher|philosopher]] who had been trapped in [[Suspended animation/Legends|cryofreeze]] aboard the lost [[Scientist/Legends|science]] vessel ''[[Prana Lexander]]'' for nearly five hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After boarding the Alliance vessel, Brawk noted this unregistered passenger and warned the Rebels that the penalty for such an infraction was seven years of hard labor. He quickly hinted to the Rebels that he was amenable to bribery. The Rebels gave him 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and he reported no violations to his superiors.<ref name="RPG" />
